rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose spoken noun phrase for a specific action attributed to someone.

example.english: Your doing that was really over the line.
example.traditional: 你做嘅嘢真係太過分喇。
example.jyutping: nei5 zou6 ge3 je5 zan1 hai6 taai3 gwo3 fan6 laa3

rows.note: Use this for someone’s deeds when stressing blame or responsibility, especially in more formal or written contexts.

example.jyutping: keoi5 ge3 so2 wai4 ling6 jan4 faat3 zi2
